newsitem.title: USA: Rubin sees need to "work together" on taxes.
newsitem.headline: Rubin sees need to "work together" on taxes.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin, after briefing Democratic senators about the weekend meetings with congressional tax negotiators, said "we just need to work together and go forward."

Asked whether the administration had prepared a tax proposal that it planned to bring to talks with congressional tax negotiators, Rubin replied: "We're ready to have discussions, but I wouldn't say that."
Sen. John Breaux, a Louisiana Democrat, said of Rubin's tax briefing: "He said the (tax talks) were going to start getting serious today and tomorrow."
